tools_used: provisioned petition text and QP cut
helpful: The frozen band in context.json and the matching sal-v4 band table made the anchor a table read rather than a derivation.
The provisioned petition text (OCR, 32 pages) was legible enough to judge the questions presented directly.
documents.json's explicit listing made it clear that no BIO exists rather than that one failed to fetch.
gaps: A pro se / counseled split on the paid scored segment would let a cell like this anchor on its own population instead of adjusting off a band rate dominated by counseled petitions.
A per-Term long-conference reschedule rate would pin the relist-increment claim for petitions sitting at one distribution to the September conference.
notes: fedcourts query with --disposition granted in the 2020s era surfaces mostly substantive applications ahead of cert petitions; a --kind petition filter, or excluding applications by default on a cert cell, would make the priors it returns more relevant.
